text.p: Holderbank Financiere Glarus AG, the world's leading cement producer, said it remained optimistic about its prospects for 1997.
"The board of directors and executive committee are optimistic about 1997," Holderbank said in its 1996 annual report.
The forecast was a repeat of Holderbank's prediction of last week when it first released its 1996 results.
Holderbank said last week it saw 1997 as promising.
"On the assumption that economic parameters in general remain essentially unchanged, Holderbank expects a positive financial outcome in 1997," it said in an April 15 statement on its 1996 results.

It said the United States and most Latin American countries remained economically strong and that favourable trends are visible in most other markets, with the exception of continued weakness in Europe. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7340
